result:
I wrote `component.html` in the notifications folder. I haven't opened it in a browser, so the layout and fonts are unchecked.

- **Content:** The "Notifications" heading, the "Mark All as Read" button and all six notifications are in exactly as you gave them, with the first three unread. The heading is shown in all caps through CSS, as DESIGN.md asks, but the text in the file is unchanged.
- **Unread rows:** They have a pale blue background, an accent dot, semibold text and an accent-colored timestamp. A screen-reader-only "Unread:" prefix keeps the state from depending on color alone.
- **Layout:** The notifications sit in one dense list card, with the text on the left and the time on the right. The page is 1280px wide with 64px margins, inside a single `<main id="component">`.
- **Design rules:** I used only the DESIGN.md colors, sizes, radii and spacing. The button is a pill at least 44px tall, with an ink fill that turns accent blue on hover.
- **Fonts:** Unbounded and Archivo are named first, but with no font files in the folder the page will fall back to system fonts unless they are installed locally.

`session.err` shows that the model name `claude-sonnet-5-5` was flagged as unrecognized. That didn't affect the output.
